nodes.label: HttpServer
nodes.desc: Builder holding sockets, keep-alive config and the user's app factory closure; run() spawns one worker thread per physical core and instantiates the factory at least once per worker.

nodes.label: H1Service
nodes.desc: Protocol service for plaintext HTTP/1.x; its ServiceFactory impl turns an accepted IO stream into a framed, dispatcher-driven connection.

nodes.label: Dispatcher
nodes.desc: Hand-written poll state machine per connection: reads bytes, decodes back-to-back requests (16-queue cap), calls the app service, and writes responses back onto the socket.

nodes.label: AppEntry
nodes.desc: ServiceFactory wrapper installed as App's endpoint; each worker resolves the app factory into a live AppRouting before serving.

nodes.label: AppInitService
nodes.desc: call() splits a raw Request into ServiceRequest + Payload, reusing pooled HttpRequest objects so steady-state traffic allocates almost nothing.

nodes.label: AppRouting
nodes.desc: The built router: recognize_fn pattern-matches the URL against ResourceDefs and runs per-resource guards, falling back to the default 404 service.

nodes.label: ResourceService
nodes.desc: Scans the matched resource's routes; the first RouteService whose guards accept the request takes it, otherwise the default service responds.

nodes.label: RouteService
nodes.desc: One per registered (method, guard) combination; check() filters, call() delegates to the boxed handler service.

nodes.label: handler_service
nodes.desc: Generic glue produced by Route::to: extracts Args::from_request, awaits handler.call, converts output through Responder::respond_to.

nodes.label: FromRequest
nodes.desc: Trait implemented by Path, Json, Data, Query, Form and more; each builds one typed handler argument from request parts and payload.

nodes.label: rt re-exports
nodes.desc: actix-rt / tokio re-exports: every worker runs its own single-threaded runtime on a dedicated thread, so no locking is needed for app state.

edges.label: bind() L515 / run() L1407 hand sockets to protocol services
